terra.problem: The furniture comparison makes the ark, a holy object, part of the joke.
The claim that Baal comes up often elsewhere in the Bible needs a Scripture reference.
The claim that Molech appears elsewhere in Scripture needs a reference.
The text says Dagon fell before the ark, but does not say the ark was not on the floor.
The text does not say the ark stayed exactly where it was put.
The text does not say the people hoped that was the end of it.
The text says people did not step on the threshold, not that they tiptoed past it.
The Philistines did do things to the ark: they captured it, carried it to Ashdod and set it beside Dagon's statue.
The text does not say the priests stepped carefully over the threshold, only that they did not step on it.
A city full of tumors overstates the affliction, and the text does not say a crowd quickly agreed.
The punchline makes the people's affliction with tumors part of the joke.
The claim that Gaza is a Philistine city comes from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Nobody in Gath got to sit this out overstates the text, which says men both young and old were afflicted.
The text does not say the Ekronites had heard about the other cities.
The joke about the ark getting its bags inside makes a holy object the joke.
The text does not say Ekron had heard what happened in Ashdod.
The text does not say how fast Ekron made its decision.
Calling it a heavy day adds a time span the text does not give.
